hypothesis: The 384-gene identity-dominated factor input may omit temporal activity genes; broader past-only coverage may improve usage dynamics.
implementation_required: Extend CellProgramTrend with an explicit feature budget and past-only selection. Create a separate feature-coverage runner; preserve all completed histories.
feature_selection_requirement: Use only unique exact-mapped source genes and permitted past rows. Start with the same variance definition as the 384-gene control to isolate coverage. Do not call it the paper's v-score selection.
comparison_requirements: Verify identical donors, floor/ceiling metric panels and gene order before comparing.
Require valid four-metric calibration and convergence audits.
Retain raw metrics, all failures and projection/support diagnostics.
Advance only after consistent paired gains on both folds; no official export from a weak mean-only gain.
adaptation_limits: The paper uses about2000 overdispersed genes and a fuller consensus procedure. This specified coverage ablation remains an adaptation, not faithful cNMF or independent embryo validation.
freeze_requirement: Write actual source/data hashes and candidate configurations before training; this specification is not an executed run plan.
decision: Converged but no consistent gains; gene-coverage ablation rejected. Family remains open.
